decisions.decision: Release versions start at 0.0.0, increase by exactly one patch step with carry at 99, and must never exceed 99.99.99. Skips, downgrades and reuse are forbidden.

Increment the ATGV version by exactly one supported base-100 patch step for each new release, update package.json, atgvDisplayVersion, README version, dashboard fallback and RELEASE.md, then create and CI-verify a PR and merge it automatically when safe. Never skip versions or release without a tested build.
